summary: {member} arrives with published design instructions that differ from what staff gave the board.
realLife: With little time to approve the Old Mint designs, members discussed a conflicting account in Coin World and set it aside for their deliberations.
inGame: needs: the staff brief and the conflicting published account.

turns.pulledBy: Staff can trace the written brief to the program.
turns.what: The chair asks staff to read the disputed instruction.
turns.writesBack: The minutes identify the version used.

turns.pulledBy: Staff find a later instruction from the program.
